content.user_title: Create Agent Skills for Claude Code
content.value_statement: Creating a useful Agent Skill requires clear scope, discoverable descriptions, and valid structure. This skill guides authors through SKILL.md, examples, testing, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Helps define a focused scope for one Agent Skill.
Explains where personal and project skills should be stored.
Provides SKILL.md frontmatter requirements and naming rules.
Shows how to structure instructions, examples, and supporting files.
Includes validation, testing, and troubleshooting checklists.
limitations: It does not install Claude Code or manage marketplace publishing.
It does not validate files with an external schema tool by itself.
It provides general authoring guidance, not domain-specific expert content.
It assumes the user can create or edit local skill files.

use_cases.title: Create a personal workflow skill
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated personal task into a focused Agent Skill with clear activation text and instructions.

use_cases.title: Standardize team skill structure
use_cases.description: Draft project skills that use consistent frontmatter, file layout, examples, and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Improve existing skill documentation
use_cases.description: Review a SKILL.md file for vague descriptions, missing examples, unclear dependencies, and activation gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner authoring a first Agent Skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Agent Skill for [task]. Ask me for missing scope, then draft the name, description, and main instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SKILL.md for activation quality. Suggest clearer trigger words, scope boundaries, and frontmatter improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Add Supporting Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Designing a larger skill with reference material.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-file Skill for [workflow]. Recommend which references, examples, scripts, and templates should be separate files.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Harden
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing a skill for team sharing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Skill for structure, allowed tools, dependencies, testing steps, and confusing instructions before team sharing.

output_examples.input: User asks for a skill that helps review pull requests.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests a focused name, activation description, review workflow, examples, and validation checks before saving SKILL.md.

output_examples.input: User shares a vague skill description for data work.
output_examples.output: The skill rewrites the description with concrete file types, user trigger phrases, operations, and clear boundaries.

output_examples.input: User wants a team skill with reference documents.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes a compact SKILL.md, separate reference files, example prompts, dependency notes, and testing steps.

best_practices: Keep each Agent Skill focused on one repeatable capability.
Use descriptions with concrete trigger phrases, file types, and operations.
Test activation with realistic user requests before sharing the skill.
anti_patterns: Combining unrelated workflows into one broad skill.
Using vague descriptions that do not explain when to activate.
Leaving required tools, dependencies, or file locations undocumented.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create Agent Skills for Claude Code, including scope, frontmatter, instructions, examples, and validation steps.

faq.question: Can it update an existing SKILL.md file?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review and improve descriptions, structure, examples, dependencies, and troubleshooting guidance.

faq.question: Does it support personal and project skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains both personal skills and project skills, including expected directory locations.

faq.question: Does it generate supporting files?
faq.answer: It can recommend references, examples, scripts, and templates when a skill needs progressive disclosure.

faq.question: Will it test skill activation automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides test prompts and checks, but the user must run the skill in their environment.

faq.question: Is it only useful for Claude Code?
faq.answer: Its guidance is written for Claude Code Agent Skills, but the authoring ideas can help Codex workflows too.
